DealerProdtSearchableField.name: DealerProdtSearchableField
DealerProdtSearchableField.description: Represents information about dealers selling and, or, servicing products for location-based searches. Helps customers find nearby dealer locations for product purchases and services.

AvailabilityDate.description: The date when the part is made available for sale or used in the product.

BusinessBrandId.description: The business brand related to a vehicle model.

BusinessBrandName.description: The name of the business brand.

BusinessPartnerType.description: The type of dealer that’s associated with a vehicle or its parts.

BusinessProfile.description: The business profile related to a dealer's account.

DealerAccount.description: The account related to a dealer's business profile.

DealerPhone.description: The phone number of the dealer.

DiscontinuedDate.description: TThe date from when the part can no longer be used or sold.

HarmonizedSystemCode.description: The code assigned to the product or a part used in the product for international trade.

HarmonizedTariffSchedCode.description: The tariff schedule code assigned to the product or part for customs classification.

IsCertified.description: Indicates whether the accessory part installed in the product is certified.

IsEnvrPrtcRegCompliant.description: Indicates whether the product is compliant with environment protection regulations.

MakeName.description: The make name of a vehicle.

ManufacturerName.description: The manufacturer name for the part used in the product.

ManufacturerPartNumber.description: The unique number assigned by the manufacturer to identify the part.

ModelName.description: The model name of a vehicle.

ModelYear.description: The model year of a vehicle.

ModelYearVersion.description: The specific iteration of a product introduced (e.g., 2021.5, 2021.75).

ProductFamily.description: The unique code of a product related to a vehicle model.

ProductId.description: The product related to a seller product.

ProductLineCode.description: The product category or line associated with the specific part.

ProductCategoryCode.description: The part category code associated with the product.

ProductName.description: The name of the product related to a vehicle model.

RegionName.description: The name of the region where the dealer operates from.

SellerProductId.description: The seller product related to a product.

SellerRole.description: The role of the seller related to the product, such as for sales or for service.

ServiceTerritoryAddress.description: The address of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryId.description: The service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

ServiceTerritoryName.description: The name of the service territory related to a dealer's business profile.

TrimType.description: The trim type of the vehicle model, such as DX, GT, or LS.

UniversalProductCode.description: The universal product code (UPC/Barcode) used to track the part.
